description: [Ncloud Storage] Get the Object Lock legal hold status of an object (GET /{key}?legal-hold): ON | OFF. Returns configured=false when the object has no legal hold setting.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

versionId.description: Version ID of the object (versioning-enabled buckets). Omit for the current version

name: ncloud_ncs_get_object_legal_hold
